name: Fast Ray-Surface Intersection
aliases: Fast Ray-Surface Intersection — Linear Interpolation Approximation for Ray-Surface Intersection
Linear Interpolation Approximation for Ray-Surface Intersection
definition: A faster alternative to exact ray-surface intersection for finding the intersection point within a boundary cell. It approximates the intersection by dividing the ray path through the cell into two equal parts.
summary: Fast Ray-Surface Intersection approximates ray-iso-surface hits by subdividing the ray and using linear interpolation, offering significantly faster performance than exact methods with visually indistinguishable results.
